name: RC-B10-0452/2026 – After recital C – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text: Ca. whereas, additionally, UN human rights experts and authors of a growing body of scientific literature have found strong evidence that economic sanctions have significantly worsened the human rights situation, damaging, in particular, the right to health by restricting the Iranian people’s access to medicines for non-communicable diseases, with dramatic impacts documented specifically for cancer patients, including for radiotherapy treatment, as well as for asthma, thalassaemia and haemophilia patients; whereas the media have also reported insulin and thyroid pill shortages, and previous rounds of sanctions even saw a 14-fold price increase for dietary formula for infants with food allergies;
